goal: Prevent disk read and write failures from silently stalling nodes or causing ungraceful crashes
Ensure nodes shut down cleanly with clear fatal errors when block storage becomes inaccessible
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Blocked by open objections over error handling architecture and regressions
Unaddressed objection: introduces a regression for index functions by ignoring errors (maflcko)
Objection: returning null on file errors loses error cause and expands nullable contracts (josibake)
Objection: leaves inconsistent exception handling across execution paths unresolved (maflcko)
Support for improving failure handling and adding thorough test coverage (frankomosh, l0rinc, rkrux, sedited)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it avoids assertion crashes and silently dropped requests during peer message processing
benefits peer serving reliability, though the underlying filesystem failures are rare

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because filesystem failures currently bypass fatal error handling and leave nodes silently stuck
ensures operational reliability and clean node termination when chain activation encounters disk errors
